purpose: Maintain one non-collapsing, source-graded unit/owner reconstruction in which title, provenance, litigation alignment, representation and later acquisition remain separate temporal edges.

publication_boundary.rule: No private contact or identity-document data from the underlying schedules/contracts is reproduced.

governing_rules: An option to purchase is not a completed sale, conveyance or registered transfer.
A touristic-exploitation cession identifying an owner does not by itself prove who sold the unit.
Representation, voting authority and legal representation do not imply ownership or beneficial interest.
The AP89 litigation-unit map and the later pre-CAM owner schedule remain parallel sources where they diverge; neither silently overwrites the other.
The full pre-CAM source denominator is 72 exact unit/premises rows plus two aggregate LPB rows; it is a derivative schedule and not Registry proof.
The source CONTACTO classification DIRECT or BANCO is not treated as seller, deed or transfer proof.
The reported twelve-unit LPB-transferee denominator is preserved as twelve reconstruction slots, not twelve invented owners.
Colour follows the dated perimeter edge, not a permanent label attached to a person.
